description: Screenshot from a Q-post aggregator app showing a side-by-side 'zero delta' proof: left panel is Trump tweet T-18103 posted 19 Jul 2020 1:14:33 PM about Obama and Biden 'SPYING' on his campaign; right panel is Q drop 4595 posted 1:14:30 PM the same day — a 3-second delta. Drop 4595 embeds a screenshot of Q drop 3537 from Jul 29 2019 ('Wray is a sleeper' / 'Future marker'), a Twitter link, and the lines 'THE SWAMP RUNS DEEP.' and 'v2_change we can believe in'. The pairing is presented as evidence of Trump–Q coordination; it demonstrates nothing beyond timestamp proximity.

description: Screenshot of a three-tweet thread by CBS reporter Catherine Herridge (@CBS_Herridge), each posted 55 minutes prior, annotated with the date '7/19/2020'. The thread reports that newly declassified FISA records released via Sen. Lindsey Graham show the system was 'blinking red' over the Steele dossier in early 2017, yet the dossier was used twice more to renew the Carter Page surveillance warrant, and cites IG Horowitz's findings including an FBI lawyer who altered an email to omit Page's prior relationship with a US intel agency. The third tweet attaches a photograph of heavily hand-annotated and partly redacted pages of the Horowitz report's Executive Summary.
